question: For these TCGA cohorts and their tissues of origin: liver hepatocellular carcinoma (liver), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (kidney), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (pancreas), lung adenocarcinoma (lung), breast invasive carcinoma (breast), colon adenocarcinoma (colon), stomach adenocarcinoma (stomach), prostate adenocarcinoma (prostate), ovary serous cystadenocarcinoma (ovary), thyroid carcinoma (thyroid gland), glioblastoma multiforme (brain), testicular germ cell tumor (testis): give the number of validated favourable and validated unfavourable prognostic genes, and how many of each are tissue enriched in the tissue of origin. Draw a grouped bar chart of the four counts per cohort and provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Cancer FROM cancer_prognostic_data ORDER BY Cancer"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Tissue FROM rna_tissue_consensus_tissues ORDER BY Tissue"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", COUNT(*) FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS favorable, \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS unfavorable, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer IN ('Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)','Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query":"WITH cohorts(cancer,tissue,ord) AS (VALUES
('Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)','liver',1),('Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)','kidney',2),('Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','pancreas',3),('Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','lung',4),('Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)','breast',5),('Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','colon',6),('Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','stomach',7),('Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','prostate',8),('Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (TCGA)','ovary',9),('Thyroid Carcinoma (TCGA)','thyroid gland',10),('Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','brain',11),('Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TCGA)','testis',12)),
mx AS (SELECT Gene, MAX(TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE)) AS max_ntpm FROM rna_tissue_consensus GROUP BY Gene),
enriched AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.Gene,r.Tissue FROM rna_tissue_consensus r JOIN mx USING(Gene) JOIN proteinatlas p USING(Gene) WHERE r.Tissue IN (SELECT tissue FROM cohorts) AND TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE)=mx.max_ntpm AND p."RNA tissue specificity"='Tissue enriched'),
x AS (SELECT c.ord,c.cancer,c.tissue,d.Gene,d."validated prognostic - favorable" fav,d."validated prognostic - unfavorable" unf, CASE WHEN e.Gene IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS origin_enriched FROM cohorts c JOIN cancer_prognostic_data d ON c.cancer=d.Cancer LEFT JOIN enriched e ON e.Gene=d.Gene AND e.Tissue=c.tissue)
SELECT cancer,tissue,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fav <> '') AS validated_favourable,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unf <> '') AS validated_unfavourable,
SUM(origin_enriched) FILTER (WHERE fav <> '') AS favourable_tissue_enriched,
SUM(origin_enriched) FILTER (WHERE unf <> '') AS unfavourable_tissue_enriched
FROM x GROUP BY ord,cancer,tissue ORDER BY ord"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT d.Gene,d.\"Gene name\",p.\"RNA tissue specificity\", r.Tissue,r.nTPM,d.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data d LEFT JOIN proteinatlas p ON d.Gene=p.Gene LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON d.Gene=r.Gene AND r.Tissue='kidney' WHERE d.Cancer='Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND d.\"validated prognostic - favorable\"<>'' LIMIT 20"}

('Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)','liver',1),('Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)','kidney',2),('Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','pancreas',3),('Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','lung',4),('Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)','breast',5),('Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','colon',6),('Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','stomach',7),('Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','prostate',8),('Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (TCGA)','ovary',9),('Thyroid Carcinoma (TCGA)','thyroid gland',10),('Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','brain',11),('Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TCGA)','testis',12)),
mx AS (SELECT Gene, MAX(TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE)) AS max_ntpm FROM rna_tissue_consensus GROUP BY Gene),
enriched AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.Gene,r.Tissue FROM rna_tissue_consensus r JOIN mx USING(Gene) JOIN proteinatlas p ON r.Gene=p.Ensembl WHERE TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE)=mx.max_ntpm AND p."RNA tissue specificity"='Tissue enriched'),
x AS (SELECT c.ord,c.cancer,c.tissue,d.Gene,d."validated prognostic - favorable" fav,d."validated prognostic - unfavorable" unf, CASE WHEN e.Gene IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS origin_enriched FROM cohorts c JOIN cancer_prognostic_data d ON c.cancer=d.Cancer LEFT JOIN enriched e ON e.Gene=d.Gene AND (e.Tissue=c.tissue OR (c.tissue='brain' AND e.Tissue IN ('amygdala','basal ganglia','cerebellum','cerebral cortex','choroid plexus','hippocampal formation','hypothalamus','midbrain','pituitary gland','retina','spinal cord'))))
SELECT cancer,tissue,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fav <> '') AS validated_favourable,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unf <> '') AS validated_unfavourable,COALESCE(SUM(origin_enriched) FILTER (WHERE fav <> ''),0) AS favourable_tissue_enriched,COALESCE(SUM(origin_enriched) FILTER (WHERE unf <> ''),0) AS unfavourable_tissue_enriched FROM x GROUP BY ord,cancer,tissue ORDER BY ord"}

turns.text:
## Validated prognostic genes and tissue-of-origin enrichment

“Tissue enriched” was counted when the gene is classified by HPA as **RNA tissue specificity = Tissue enriched** and its highest consensus RNA expression is in the stated tissue of origin. For **brain**, the HPA brain-region tissues were treated as brain tissue.

| TCGA cohort | Tissue of origin | Validated favourable | Favourable, tissue-enriched in origin | Validated unfavourable | Unfavourable, tissue-enriched in origin |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Liver hepatocellular carcinoma | liver | 113 | 45 | 939 | 0 |
| Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma | kidney | 1,639 | 16 | 264 | 0 |
| Pancreatic adenocarcinoma | pancreas | 4 | 0 | 134 | 0 |
| Lung adenocarcinoma | lung | 5 | 0 | 202 | 0 |
| Breast invasive carcinoma | breast | 5 | 0 | 4 | 0 |
| Colon adenocarcinoma | colon | 5 | 0 | 3 | 0 |
| Stomach adenocarcinoma | stomach | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Prostate adenocarcinoma | prostate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ovary serous cystadenocarcinoma | ovary | 0 | 0 | 17 | 0 |
| Thyroid carcinoma | thyroid gland | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Glioblastoma multiforme | brain | 12 | 0 | 57 | 0 |
| Testicular germ cell tumor | testis | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

cancer_cancers (0.0 MB): Cancer, Organ
